in_sanskrit.name: दत्तात्रय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives to the three (Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva)

in_marathi.name: Dattatray
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Given by God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dattatray हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dattatray is a name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Datta’ (given) and ‘Tray’ (God). This name is given to those who believe in the power of the gods and seek their guidance in life. In Hindu mythology, Dattatray is the name of Lord Dattatreya, a deity who is revered as the embodiment of three gods – Lord Brahma, Lord Vishnu, and Lord Shiva.
